title: Men's Christian – Short Grace. Hot Food. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Christian Zip Up Hoodie for Men – Short Grace. Hot Food.
seo.description: A christian zip up hoodie for men: SHORT GRACE. HOT FOOD. on the back over a family praying at dinner, plus stitched HOT FOOD. on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This christian zip up hoodie for men is for the dad who keeps the blessing short because the roast is getting cold, zipped on for Sunday dinner and the walk home from church.

A family at a dinner table with heads bowed in grace, a dad in an orange plaid shirt with hands pressed together beside two children, a steaming roast and a basket of rolls on a striped tablecloth, in orange, cream, brown and mustard with a worn print texture. SHORT GRACE. runs above the table in two lines and HOT FOOD. below in two lines of fat rounded capitals: cream and coral on Black and Navy, navy and rust on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small HOT over FOOD. wordmark in the same rounded capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word AMEN is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest HOT FOOD. wordmark and left-cuff AMEN, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Short Grace. Hot Food. zip hoodie fit?
The Short Grace. Hot Food. christian zip up hoodie for men from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this christian for men hoodie warm enough for chilly church parking lots?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles chilly church parking lots, Sunday dinners and the walk home after the service well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, SHORT GRACE. above the family and HOT FOOD. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small HOT over FOOD. wordmark in the same rounded capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and AMEN is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The HOT FOOD. wordmark on the chest and the AMEN cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a dad, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the dad who keeps grace short so the food stays hot. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
